thread:
Mara: Quick Q2 OKR milestone check-in — post a 1‑line: shipped / slipped / next step / owner / deps. Please by EOD PT. Focus: Runtime perf, routing policy, console telemetry.

Asif: Runtime V2 — shipped core KV-cache + batching perf (merged). Next: run perf matrix on staging and validate latency SLOs. Owner: Asif. Deps: eng-infra for new perf counters (Lina). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4147 :shipit:

Jin: Routing policy — slipped. Canary showed cold-start regression at p99 for short-context traces. Reverting canary is an option but I want to try a patch first. Owner: Jin. Next step: rollback or patch by Thu EOD. Dep: extra GPU capacity from ops for canary testing. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4219 :eyes:

Sofia: Console rollout — feature flags and basic dashboards shipped, but A/B telemetry and cost breakdowns slipped (need analytics wiring). Owner: Sofia. Next: finish telemetry pipeline + validation tests. Dep: analytics & infra (Lina).

Lina: Eng‑infra update — rolling out perf counters and ingest path for console telemetry, ETA Wed morning. Also addressing a minor schema change that affected embeddings billing. Will post infra-runbook when done.

Asif: quick ping @Lina — the KV cache exposes `cache_hit_ratio` and `batch_size` metrics. Can you map those to `redwood.runtime.kv.*` and add to the perf dashboard? Snippet for metrics export:```promql
redwood_runtime_kv_hit_ratio{env=\"staging\"}
```

Lina: got it, adding mappings now. Will also add alert for p99 latency > 200ms.

Jin: small CR request: PR 4219 needs two approvals. @Mara can you glance at the rollout policy changes in `routing/policy.go`? Short diff:```diff
- fallback: \"small-model\"
+ fallback: chooseByCostTier(request)
```

Mara: I can review tonight, thanks. If it's risky we can pin the canary and do a hotfix.

Sofia: tagging @Jin and @Asif for final CRs on console telemetry shims — small interface change to `TelemetryClient.send()` that affects routing logs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4233

Asif: noted, I'll queue a quick review tomorrow morning. If you need me sooner ping in #eng-runtime.

DeployBot: [deploy] staging/runtime-v2 deployed at 2026-03-04T19:12:00Z — no errors in smoke tests.

Mara: Recap: shipped — Runtime core perf, console flags. Slipped — routing policy canary, console telemetry A/B. Next: perf validation (Asif), canary patch or rollback (Jin), telemetry wiring (Sofia/Lina). I'll collate this into the OKR doc later today. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
